## AOI AMCI_SD4840E2_Program_Assembed_Move

| Effect | Via | Where | Causes / conditions | Comment |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| comment_coil | OTE | AOI AMCI_SD4840E2_Program_Assembed_Move/Logic:0 | (unconditional) | The following logic can be used to program between two and sixteen segments of an AMCI SD4840E2's assembled move. |
| command_data_block[0].12 | OTU | AOI AMCI_SD4840E2_Program_Assembed_Move/Logic:19 | Axis_Status_Bits.8, ~Axis_Status_Bits.9, Assembled_Move_counter | The SD4840E2 driver acknowledges the receipt of a assembled programming block by resetting bit SD4840E2_Status_Word_0.9.  When this bit is set, increment the counter controlling which programming block is being output, and unlatch the Read assembled Data bit Command_data_block[0].12.  This bit, along with bit 11 (the Program Assembled Move Profile bit)  is set in word 0 of each of the assembled segment's programming blocks. |
| Assembled_Move_Programmed | OTL | AOI AMCI_SD4840E2_Program_Assembed_Move/Logic:20 | Assembled_Move_counter.DN, 0, -32768 | If the counter Done bit is set, all of the Assembled Move Profile's programming blocks have been sent to the SMD23E driver.  When this bit is set, exit Assembled Move mode by resetting Control Word 1 to zero.  To keep the driver enabled, Control Word 2 is set to -32768.  The remaining eight output words assigned to the SMD23E are also reset to zero. |
